eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus in the Los Angeles temperature market centers on 68–71°F outcomes because National Weather Service point forecasts for Los Angeles International Airport show a daytime high near 70–72°F under a persistent marine layer and moderate onshore flow. These conditions, typical for early June along the coast, limit daytime warming by advecting cooler Pacific air and promoting low stratus that reduces insolation. Slight model differences in the timing of marine-layer clearing or sea-breeze strength create the narrow spread between the two leading brackets. Historical climatology for early June at the official station reinforces this range, with average highs around 71°F and low variability absent strong offshore winds or anomalous warming aloft. Resolution occurs at midnight local time once the official climatological report is issued.
